visualCharacteristics.purpose: sticky in-page navigation bar linking to sections of the same page, highlighting the section in view
visualCharacteristics.layout: single non-wrapping row of links (horizontal scroll on narrow screens, centred from 900px); fixed to the top of the viewport once scrolled past

contentPattern.structure: one row, one cell: links to '#id' anchors on the same page (bulleted list or one link per paragraph); links whose target id is not on the page are hidden

reuseGuidance: Use for 'jump to' bars on long product pages. Link targets must be ids present on the page (heading ids, e.g. #content-and-resources).
